title: Hartmann's Versus Primary Anastomosis in Left-sided Colon Perforation
brief_summary: The purpose of this multi-center randomized trial is to identify any differences in the complication rates of patients undergoing Hartmann's (end colostomy) versus Primary Anastomosis (with defunctioning ileostomy) for left-sided colonic performation (including the stoma reversal operation).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient age \> 18 years
* Left-sided colon perforation
* German language speakers

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient age \< 18 years
* Perforation outside of the left-colon
* Bowel obstruction/disease without perforation
* Evidence of metastasis
